propositions: Introduce a new `.bridge_state/get_rotation.json` sidecar file to persist GET rotation state separately from inline legacy fields.
Implement dual-write persistence: all new rotation stamps must be written to both the sidecar and legacy inline field during rollout to maintain interleaved binary compatibility.
Load rotation state by taking max(sidecar_value, legacy_inline_value) for each Jira key to handle mixed-version scenarios and ensure forward progress.
Sidecar persistence occurs only through BindingStore.save() paths, not during reconcile-check, to avoid creating files during read-only operations.
Extract rotation accessor logic into a focused module to keep outbound_differ.py at or below 800 lines while maintaining dual-write coverage.
Include GET_ROTATION_FILE in explicit git staging list and regenerable-files documentation so both rotation representations land in a single atomic commit.
